title: pulci.toml
description: Schema for pulci.toml project configuration. All sections are optional.

hooks.description: Controls which quality-gate adapters are active.

ruff.description: Run ruff check on changed .py files.

ty.description: Run ty check on changed .py files.

pytest.description: Run pytest on tests/test_<changed>.py for each changed source file.

clippy.description: Run cargo clippy on the workspace (intended for Rust projects using pulci on itself).

timeout_secs.description: Per-hook subprocess wall-clock timeout in seconds. Applies uniformly to every enabled hook. Omit (or null) to use the default of 120. Useful for projects whose pytest suite or cold cargo clippy legitimately exceeds 120s.

tools.description: Pin exact tool versions. Absent fields are auto-resolved via local-venv → PATH → uvx.

ruff.description: Pin ruff to this version, e.g. "0.7.4". Uses uvx ruff@<version>.

ty.description: Pin ty to this version, e.g. "0.0.3". Uses uvx ty@<version>.

pytest.description: Pin pytest to this version, e.g. "8.3.0". Uses uvx pytest@<version>.

watch.description: Controls which paths the daemon watches and scans.

exclude.description: Relative paths (from project root) to exclude from watching. E.g. ["benchmarks/fixture"].
